description: Tracy baseline capture script — 3 active video layers, 2 output screens, 30 seconds (~1800 frames at 60 Hz) of continuous playback. Run this while Tracy.exe is connected to produce the issue #43 baseline .tracy file. Assets used are from test_media/ (checked into the repo). If you want a higher-fidelity baseline with real production content, swap the ImportVideo paths for your actual clips and re-record.
_assets_required: test_media/hap_gradient/test.mov  — HAP codec, repo test asset (3 tracks)
test_media/blend_bg/frame_000.png — PNG sequence, repo test asset (used as track 1 fill)
test_media/blend_fg/frame_000.png — PNG sequence, repo test asset (used as track 2 fill)
_how_to_capture: 1. Build: cmake --build build --config Release  (ENTITY_ENABLE_TRACY=ON, the default)
3. While the editor is running, open Tracy.exe (v0.13.1 from https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy/releases)
4. Click Connect. Two frame contexts appear: Editor and Show.
5. Let the script run its 1800-frame (~30s) playback loop.
7. Post median Editor frame ms / Show frame ms / p95 each / GPU mean into issue #43.
